entries.name: SELECT Statement
entries.description: SELECT 문은 절을 SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT 순서로 씁니다. 실행 순서는 FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY → LIMIT에 가깝습니다.
entries.syntax:
SELECT COLUMNS
FROM TABLE
WHERE CONDITION
GROUP BY COLUMNS
HAVING CONDITION
ORDER BY COLUMNS
LIMIT N;
examples:
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM users
WHERE age >= 20
GROUP BY city
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 5;

entries.name: Join Clause
entries.description: FROM 뒤에 JOIN 종류, 합칠 테이블, ON 조건으로 이루어진 절. 여러 번 이어 붙일 수 있습니다.
entries.syntax:
FROM A
  INNER|LEFT JOIN B ON A.KEY = B.KEY

entries.name: Subquery
entries.description: 괄호 안에 다른 SELECT를 넣어 값, 목록, 임시 테이블로 쓰는 문법. WHERE의 IN/EXISTS, FROM 뒤, SELECT 목록에 둘 수 있습니다.
entries.syntax: WHERE COL IN (SELECT COL FROM OTHER WHERE ...)
examples:
SELECT name FROM users
WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total > 10000);
